description: This file is a shell script that provides a wrapper for starting, stopping, checking, and signaling services using start-stop-daemon. It defines functions to manage services with configurable environment variables and parameters.

methods.name: service
methods.description: Main function that wraps start-stop-daemon to manage service actions such as start, stop, check, and reload.

methods.name: service_check
methods.description: Checks if a service is alive using start-stop-daemon with the -C action.

methods.name: service_signal
methods.description: Sends a signal to a service (default USR1) using start-stop-daemon with the -K action.

methods.name: service_start
methods.description: Starts a service using start-stop-daemon with the -S action.

methods.name: service_stop
methods.description: Stops a service gracefully, sending the specified signal, with fallback to KILL after a timeout.

methods.name: service_reload
methods.description: Reloads a service by sending it the reload signal.
